description: This file defines the main API application for a notes management backend, including route definitions for user registration, authentication, CRUD operations on notes, search, and health check. It uses FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and authentication dependencies, serving as the central entry point for the backend API.

methods.name: get_db()
methods.description: Dependency for providing a database session, ensuring session closure after use.

methods.name: register(user: schemas.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with username, email, and password.

methods.name: login_token(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user and generate a JWT access token.

methods.name: read_users_me(current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the current authenticated user's information.

methods.name: create_note(note: schemas.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new note linked to the current user.

methods.name: list_notes(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of current user's notes, ordered by last edited time.

methods.name: read_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by ID, if owned by the current user.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, note: schemas.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the specified note if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a note if owned by the current user.

methods.name: search_notes(q: str = Query(..., description="Search string in title or content"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Searches user's notes for a substring in title or content, ordered by last edited time.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Simple endpoint to check API health status.

methods.name: on_startup()
methods.description: Runs at application startup to initialize database tables.
